gloss: parody song; song with altered lyrics

definitions.gloss: parody song; song with altered lyrics sung to a familiar melody
definitions.explanation: A version of an existing song where the original lyrics have been replaced with humorous, satirical, or otherwise different words while keeping the same melody. Popular as entertainment among children and in comedy.

examples.japanese: {替|か}え{歌|うた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made up a parody song.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{替|か}え{歌|うた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歌|うた}って→歌う：00684_utau⟧⟦{笑|わら}っている→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: The children are singing a parody song and laughing.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{替|か}え{歌|うた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: That comedian gained popularity with parody versions of famous songs.

notes:
Compound of {替|か}え (replacement, from ⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧) and ⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧ (song). The concept is similar to English parody songs — the melody stays the same but the lyrics are changed, usually for humorous effect.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {替|か}え{歌|うた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to create a parody song
- {替|か}え{歌|うた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧: to sing a parody song
- {替|か}え{歌|うた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to turn into a parody song

CULTURAL NOTE:
Parody songs are a staple of Japanese comedy (⟦お{笑|わら}い→お笑い：10298_owarai⟧). Comedians like Shimura Ken and Hiro Iki have made {替|か}え{歌|うた} a popular entertainment format. Children also commonly create {替|か}え{歌|うた} of school songs and popular tunes.
